text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After an outing with Katsuragi Ace, we 
bumped into Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You've come at just the right time. Would 
you care to come along? There is an 
interesting place I'd like to show you."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: An interesting place...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Wait, it's a party!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where I was brought was a prestigious 
party venue where race officials gathered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I despise pre-established harmony. With 
you joining in, I'm sure a new harmony 
will emerge. Please, enjoy yourself 
however you like."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Not totally sure what's going 
on, but let's have fun...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace looks a little tense. I 
should do my best to support her so she 
can make the most of this opportunity...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so we can eat as much as we want. All 
right, then for now I'll pile on as much 
as—
choice_data_list:
With stuff like this, you have to add it 
little by little.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so! Well, I guess I'll go with 
this for now...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like someone lost this. Does this 
ring a bell for anyone~?
choice_data_list:
At times like this, let's leave it to the 
staff.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? If I'm not mistaken, you're Katsuragi 
Ace-kun, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Uhh, yeah, pretty much...?
choice_data_list: Hello, I'm her Trainer. And you are?

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, pardon me. I'm involved in the 
management of the URA. I've actually been 
keeping an eye on you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see...! Allow me to introduce myself 
again: I'm Katsuragi Ace. I'm honored by 
your interest!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I thought parties were all stiff 
and stuffy, but they're actually pretty 
fun. Broadens your horizons, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace's expression seemed much 
calmer than before. Just as I felt a wave 
of relief—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly the ship sways violently, 
throwing me off balance. Just as I thought 
I was going to fall—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Kh, are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"That was a pretty rough shake... Let's 
find somewhere to sit down. Here, take my 
hand."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just sit here. Judging by the wind, the 
boat's gonna be rocking for a while.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"No, the thanks go to you. Sorry for 
causing you trouble earlier... Appreciate 
it."

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If I'm not mistaken, you're Katsuragi 
Ace-kun, right? I happen to develop 
training equipment, and—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. I've pretty much got the 
manners down. Trainer, you just sit back 
and relax."

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
"We released this bench press machine a 
little while ago, and I've been going 
around gathering feedback on it."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, we use that at our academy too. It 
helps stabilize your form and gives a 
well-balanced workout."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Along with the farm muscles I built from 
working the fields, I feel like my body's 
getting into really solid shape.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Ho, 'farm muscles'... I see. Linking the 
muscles used in daily life with targeted 
training. That's a perspective I hadn't 
considered before...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Mejiro Ramonu-san. This 
girl's talk about 'farmer muscles' is 
quite fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Truly. Would you care to tell me more 
details?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back already, huh... Thirsty, 
Trainer? I'll go grab us something, sit 
tight.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "—Excuse me, staff. Two drinks, please."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She quickly mastered party etiquette and 
carried herself with absolute dignity. Her 
sudden transformation into someone so 
reliable left me in complete awe.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Doesn't this 
look amazing? They said it's a mixed 
juice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when you think she's grown up so 
fast, she shows an innocent face like 
this... It is strangely endearing and puts 
one at ease.
choice_data_list: An ace is truly an ace, after all.
An ace is truly an ace, after all.

Since we're here, let's make the most of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when you think she's grown up so 
fast, she shows an innocent face like 
this... It is strangely endearing and puts 
one at ease.
choice_data_list: An ace is truly an ace, after all.
An ace is truly an ace, after all.

Since we're here, let's make the most of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter where she is, she is always 
naturally herself—and deeply reliable.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You don't even have to say it—I'm 
definitely gonna become the ace of the 
Umamusume world! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finding her slightly off-the-mark reaction 
charmingly typical of Ace, we enjoyed our 
juice together.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! The food's delicious, and I 
wanna talk to even more people!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Once we finish our juice and take a 
breather, let's head back out to the deck!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, once she had gotten completely 
used to the atmosphere, we thoroughly 
enjoyed the party together.
